entries.original_title: Discovery and preclinical validation of drug indications using compendia of public gene expression data
entries.original_authors: Sirota, M; Dudley, J; Kim, J; Chiang, A; Morgan, A; Sweet-Cordero, A; Sage, J; Butte, A
entries.description: Cimetidine treatment reduces tumor volume in A549 lung adenocarcinoma xenografts compared to vehicle control
entries.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 4C–D and Supplemental Figure 1 of Sirota et al., 2011.
entries.notes: The replication effect (d=0.93, 95% CI [0.12, 1.72]) was in the expected direction but not statistically significant at the pre-registered Bonferroni threshold (p=0.105). The authors use hedging language ('While not statistically significant'). The meta-analysis of original and replication was significant (p=0.0043), but the replication alone is inconclusive per the codebook's qualified support rule.
